mapper.insert: insert into mxk_role_member(id, roleid, memberid, type, createddate, instid) values (#{id}, #{roleId}, #{memberId}, #{type}, current_timestamp, #{instId})
mapper.select:
select distinct u.id, u.username, u.usertype, u.windowsaccount,
u.displayname, u.nickname, u.namezhspell, u.namezhshortspell, u.givenname, u.middlename, u.familyname,
u.gender,
u.authntype, u.mobile, u.email, u.workemail, u.workphonenumber,
u.employeenumber, u.division, u.costcenter, u.organization, u.departmentid, u.department, u.jobtitle, u.joblevel,
u.createddate,
u.status from mxk_userinfo u where instid = #{instId}

select distinct u.* from mxk_userinfo u join mxk_role_member rm on rm.memberid = u.id and rm.instid = u.instid join mxk_roles r on r.id = rm.roleid and r.instid = u.instid where rm.roleid = #{value} and rm.type in ('USER', 'USER-DYNAMIC')
